title: neo4j.com/blog/startups/neo4j-aura-startup-guide
snippet:
And the tiers themselves, if you just want the numbers:
- **Free**: $0. Learn and prototype, with one free instance per account and every graph tool included.
- **Professional**: $65/GB/month, 1GB minimum. Up to 128GB memory per instance, scalable on demand, daily backups.
- **Business Critical**: $146/GB/month, 2GB minimum. Up to 1944GB (GCP) or 512GB (AWS/Azure), a 99.95% uptime SLA, and 24×7 support.
Storage is available of up to 1:16 memory ratio.

title: neo4j.com/videos/getting-started-with-aura-free-tier
snippet:
In a nutshell,[ AuraDB Free](https://neo4j.com/product/auradb/) is Neo4j’s **free-tier cloud database**. It’s built for beginners, hobbyists, and developers who want to experiment with graph data models without worrying about infrastructure or costs.
And yes—it’s always free. No credit card. No time limit.

Here’s what you get with the free tier:
- Support for **up to 200,000 nodes** and **400,000 relationships
- A **fully managed**, cloud-native experience
- Access to[ Neo4j Enterprise Studio](https://neo4j.com/product/enterprise-studio/), a powerful tool for graph visualization
- Easy integration with GraphQL, Apache Kafka, and BI tools
And when you outgrow the free tier, scaling up to[ Professional or Enterprise](https://neo4j.com/cloud/platform/aura-graph-database/faq/) plans is seamless.

title: Free trial - Neo4j Aura
snippet:
The Aura free trial applies to either **AuraDB Professional** or **AuraDB Business Critical** and gives you access to [Graph Analytics in Aura](https://neo4j.com/docs/graph-analytics/), [Aura Agent](https://neo4j.com/docs/aura-agent/), [Virtual Graph](https://neo4j.com/docs/virtual-graph/), and other products and features. The free trial grants you $150 in credits, valid for 14 days. Use the trial to explore the platform, prototype your application, and plan your workload for production.
## Get started with the free trial
1. Create a [Neo4j Aura](https://console.neo4j.io/) account
2. Complete the sign-up process, you will be prompted to start a 14-day free trial. Alternatively, you can start a free trial from the [Instances page](https://console.neo4j.io/instances/create).

Your free trial includes:
- 14 days and $150 in Aura credits, valid from the start of your trial.
- **AuraDB Professional**: a production-grade, fully-managed graph database.
- **AuraDB Business Critical**: high availability with multi-AZ architecture and 99.95% uptime SLA.
- **Aura Graph Analytics**: run 65+ graph algorithms directly on your data.
- Full access to all other Aura platform features, within the Trial limits.
Your trial ends either after 14 days or when your $150 credits are fully consumed. You can check your remaining balance at any time in the [Aura Billing page](https://console.neo4j.io/billing).
## Trial limits
To prevent accidental overuse, the following limits are in place during the free trial:
- AuraDB Professional/Business Critical:
- Maximum number of **running** instances: 1
- Maximum instance size: 4GB memory
- Aura Graph Analytics
- Maximum size: 8GB memory
- Maximum concurrent sessions: 3
- Aura Agent
- Maximum number of external agents: 1
- Virtual Graphs
- Maximum instance size: 4GB memory
- Maximum number of running instances: 1

The Free tier is available indefinitely, but has limitations compared to the paid plans. See the [Neo4j Pricing page](https://neo4j.com/pricing/) for details.

title: neo4j.com/blog/news/announcing-early-access-neo4j-aura-free-tier
snippet:
Today, we take an important step towards this reality. We are thrilled to announce Early Access for Neo4j AuraDB Free, a completely free tier of Neo4j’s database as a service allowing you to learn, test, prototype, and explore your ideas without barriers. With the free tier, you can get started in a few clicks, learn graphs, test your models, or build a prototype without any costs or hosting burdens.
#### It is free, forever
With AuraDB Free tier, there are no trials, no time limits, no promo codes, and no credit card required. You now have a personal, fully managed Neo4j database running for you 24/7 that you never have to worry about or pay for. Spun up in a minute, available via [Browser](https://neo4j.com/developer/neo4j-browser/?ref=blog), [Neo4j Enterprise Studio](https://neo4j.com/product/enterprise-studio/), or [Bolt](https://neo4j.com/labs/apoc/4.1/database-integration/bolt-neo4j/?ref=blog), you can start connecting your apps or hosting your data immediately.

title: graphacademy.neo4j.com/courses/aura-cli/4-the-instance-lifecycle/2-create-free-instance
snippet:
The free tier settles everything else, because a free instance has exactly one configuration:
- **Type:** `free-db`, running Neo4j version 5
- **Size:** 1GB memory
- **Location:** GCP, in `europe-west1` (Belgium)
There is no menu to consult, because there is nothing to choose. Each account gets one free instance, capped at 200,000 [nodes](https://graphacademy.neo4j.com/glossary/node) and 400,000 [relationships](https://graphacademy.neo4j.com/glossary/relationship), with no credit card required. Everything you practice on it transfers unchanged to the paid tiers, where the same `instance create` command gains the sizing flags you explored in the tenant configuration menu.
